B-owned Pricing quote-validation integration only when accepted contracts and verified W02 producers are available

evidenceScope: Declarative acceptance specification only. No Billing persistence, business HTTP, PostgreSQL constraint, broker recovery, browser flow or W03 acceptance is executed or established by this file.

entryBlockers.meaning: E-published verified BASE_W03 and accepted W02 Catalog/Pricing behavior; reconcile the base/ownership/lease records before dependent writes.
Accepted Billing/Booking/Pricing commands, quote references, responses, errors, event envelopes and compatible client exports.
Approved accounting/financial policy, account categories/posting triggers, money/currency/precision, quote validity, cancellation, reversal and replay/time semantics.
Accepted and implemented service identity, current actor/guest ownership, delegation and critical-operation authorization.
E-owned package dependencies/exports, Gateway transport, broker permissions and published executable gates/provider wiring.
E-allocated and actually provisioned isolated PostgreSQL/broker/runtime resources, pinned toolchain and scoped ownership/cleanup evidence.
Downstream serialized real provider/consumer integration and unchanged-ref candidate/target acceptance; not a prerequisite that makes the first provider child depend on its unbuilt consumer.

notes: Observed main is an audit source, not BASE_W03. All cases remain NOT_RUN_SPECIFICATION_ONLY and runtimeExecuted=false.

Billing currently has only ServiceMarker persistence and a historical pure assertBalancedJournal helper. Its regex/entry limits and successful unit assertions are not approved accounting policy or database enforcement.

Policy-derived valid/invalid test vectors must come from explicitly accepted revisions. No currency code, exponent, price, account number, lifetime, deadline, fee, tax or numerical production limit is selected here.

Account categories and journal-producing events must be approved before implementation. Creating an intent or recording an amount due never establishes money collection, custody, settlement or earned revenue by itself.

Database constraints, row privileges, immutable posting controls and transactional posting interfaces described below are implementation requirements for B with E-owned technical provisioning/wiring. They are not present or executed at the observed source.

Provider children use real owned PostgreSQL, Identity and accepted merged dependencies before downstream Booking/app integration. Integration evidence cannot be replaced by fixture schemas or a circular prerequisite.
Test-only policies and Booking/Pricing fixtures remain labeled isolated fixtures; never production defaults or evidence of real Booking, capacity or financial acceptance.

The accepted quote-validity/consumption contract must resolve the time between Pricing verification and Billing commit; no unaccepted lock, exclusive consumption rule or fabricated distributed transaction is introduced.
Compensation within W03 cancels due obligations or reverses approved W03 accounting effects. It never executes cash collection, provider refunds, Wallet settlement or next-wave business work.

Every executed future case must record exact command, result, source/tree and allocated runtime identity. Missing, skipped, failed, cancelled or fixture-only required evidence keeps the relevant child/parent gate open.
